command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
$expectedMain="20876753e83c391cd35e0b792b864b576e21bafe"
$targetBranch="fix/central-ci-m19-m20-panel-handoff"
$expectedTarget="6c1854275a4da4618ca8a61ed258869ea88c4a75"
if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $repo -PathType Container)){throw "Canonical checkout missing"}
& git -C $repo fetch origin main --no-tags
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "Main fetch failed"}
$observedMain=(& git -C $repo rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim()
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $observedMain -ne $expectedMain){throw "main SHA drift"}
$remoteRef="refs/heads/$targetBranch"
$found=@(& git -C $repo ls-remote --heads origin $remoteRef)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $found.Count -ne 1){throw "Expected single stale branch missing"}
$observed=([string]$found[0] -split '\s+')[0].ToLowerInvariant()
if($observed -ne $expectedTarget){throw "Stale branch head changed"}
Write-Host "STALE_PR53_BRANCH_PREFLIGHT=PASS"
$lease="--force-with-lease=$($remoteRef):$expectedTarget"
& git -C $repo push $lease origin ":$remoteRef"
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "Stale PR53 branch delete failed"}
Write-Host "STALE_PR53_BRANCH_DELETED=$targetBranch"
$rem=@(& git -C $repo ls-remote --heads origin)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "Remote branch verification failed"}
$actual=@($rem | ForEach-Object {if($_ -match "refs/heads/(.+)$"){$Matches[1]}})
$required=@("main","control/remote-shell","evidence/remote-windows")
$unknown=@($actual | Where-Object {$_ -notin $required})
$missing=@($required | Where-Object {$_ -notin $actual})
if($unknown.Count -ne 0 -or $missing.Count -ne 0){throw "Unexpected remaining refs: $($actual -join ',')"}
Write-Host "STALE_PR53_BRANCH_CLEANUP_VERIFIED=PASS remaining=$($actual -join ',')"
